sentences.text:
Gopal Sarkar vs Unknown on 10 July, 2025
10.07.2025 Item No.06.
Daily List Court No.42 Mithun In The High Court At Calcutta.

CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS JURISDICTION CRM (R) 82 of 2025 In re : An Application for bail under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. in connection with Barasat Police Station Case No.792 of 2023 dated 08.11.2023 corresponding to G.R.
NO.3292 of 2023 under Sections 376(2)(n)/506 of Indian Penal Code and under Sections 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, subsequently Charge Sheet submitted under Section 376(2)(n)/506 of Indian Penal Code and under Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: -And- In the matter of : Gopal Sarkar ... ... Petitioner (in Jail) Mr. Soumik Ganguli ... ...
For the Petitioner Ms. Sreyashee Biswas, Ms. Sonali Bhar ... ...
For the State Affidavit-of-service filed on behalf of the petitioner is taken on record.
Although, it appears that service has been effected upon the de facto complainant/victim but the notice is made in English language.
Accordingly, let the State effect service and file a service report on the next date.

In the notice to be served by the State, it should be mentioned that the de-facto complainant/victim has a right to be represented through a lawyer to be engaged by the Calcutta High Court Legal Services Committee for which no cost need be borne by the de-facto complainant/victim.

entities.text: Calcutta High Court Legal Services Committee
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The notice should be in a language which the de-facto complainant /victim can comprehend.
State is also directed to file status report of the trial on the returnable date.

In the status report to be filed, the State shall indicate the stage of the trial, the number of charge sheet named witnesses, the number of witnesses examined so far, how many more witnesses the prosecution proposes to examine, whether or not the petitioner has criminal antecedents and any other relevant factors.

(Bivas Pattanayak, J.)
